twin_policy.note: R_factor is a declared team policy, not a physical constant (dossier section 7.5)

missing_value_policy: Required fields: FAIL. Optional fields: explicit null plus reason. No silent imputation.
unit_policy: Every numeric value carries a UCUM-style unit; '1' marks a dimensionless value.
epistemic_policy: origin MEASURED or SIMULATED; value_epistemic MEASURED, DERIVED, INFERRED or SIMULATED; a SIMULATED origin is never labelled MEASURED.

digital_twin_requirements.coordinate_link: spatial_reference gives the frame (scanner or registered_anatomical) and VOI or mask
digital_twin_requirements.uncertainty: required for every value used in a state update
